title: Oven Roasted Norwegian Chive Skillet
description: A flavorful Norwegian dish featuring Asian-chive-buchu, perfect for a special occasion, with a molten and floral presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine chopped Asian chives, dried Buchu leaves, and minced garlic.
In a separate bowl, mix together shredded Norwegian cheese, sliced potatoes, salt, and black pepper.
In a large oven-safe skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add the potato and cheese mixture to the skillet and cook until the potatoes are slightly browned.
Add the chive and Buchu mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
